chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Abu Ismail Ibrahim ibn Is'haq al-Azdi, from Abu Uthman al-Abdi, from Ja'far, from his forefathers, from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no speech except with a deed, and there is neither speech nor deed except with an intention, and there is neither speech nor deed nor intention except with attaining the Sunnah.

key_terms.إِصَابَة السُّنَّة: Attaining/conforming to the Sunnah — aligning one's conduct with the established prophetic practice
key_terms.عَمَل: Deed, act, work — practical fulfillment of what is said
key_terms.قَوْل: Speech, utterance — here used in the sense of verbal commitment or declaration
key_terms.نِيَّة: Intention — the conscious purpose behind an action, essential for its spiritual validity

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the relationship between speech, deed, intention, and the Sunnah?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) transmits this foundational teaching of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), which establishes a three-tiered hierarchy of authentic action: speech must be backed by deed, deed must be backed by intention, and all of these must be grounded in adherence to the Sunnah. This hadith addresses the community of believers who might speak without acting, act without intention, or intend without aligning to prophetic guidance — teaching that only through conformity to the Sunnah can one's words, deeds, and intentions reach their proper spiritual merit.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abu Ismail Ibrahim Bin Is’haq Al Azdy, from Abu Usman Al Abady, 
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup>, from Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There is no word except with the deed, and there is neither a word nor a deed except with an intention, and there is neither a word nor a deed nor an intention except with attaining the Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from abu ’Isma‘il Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Azdi from abu ‘Uthman al-‘Abdi from Ja’far from his ancestors from Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) who has said the following.

“There are no words without action, thee are no words or actions without intention and there are no words, actions and intentions without learning the Sunnah, the noble traditions of the holy Prophet, (s.a.).
